## Summary
Fixed 3 bugs found during unit_commit retest: stale unit-check.json blocking detection forever, invalid config keys crashing git-auto silently, and catchup preempting unit_commit. Committed (00fd4b1, 21cd2e3), pushed branch fix/unit-commit-stale-state-and-config, opened PR #5. Verified all 3 fixes locally against the real git-auto binary (not just the stub in test-start-git-auto.sh) — both stale-sweep and crash-detection scenarios reproduced exactly as reported and confirmed fixed.

## Key Decisions
- Sweep "any unit-check.json present at SessionStart = orphaned" (no TTL): user said "catchup and updates should always be possible" — time-based locks could block legitimate work; presence-at-start is deterministic and safe
- Surface stale unit-check contents via STALE_UNIT_CHECK marker before deleting: user caught that blind rm would silently lose uncommitted-work context — now carries timestamp/files/stat_summary forward
- PID-liveness + log-tail check after daemon launch (not narrow config-key validator): catches ANY startup crash generically, more robust than special-casing claude_handshake/claude_timeout
- Mirrored Step 2.5 warning in both skills/configure/SKILL.md and commands/configure.md: these two drift apart historically, kept in sync deliberately

## Files Changed
- scripts/start-git-auto.sh: stale unit-check sweep at top of script + daemon crash detection (PID liveness, log tail)
- scripts/stop-git-auto.sh: also clean up unit-check.json on stop
- scripts/test-start-git-auto.sh: new — stub-binary regression test for both fixes
- skills/configure/SKILL.md, commands/configure.md, README.md: Step 2.5 warning when catchup+unit_commit both true
